about.title: About AlterTracker
about.intro_1: AlterTracker was born out of a real need within the Altered TCG community: to efficiently reference, search, and analyze the game's cards.
about.intro_2: As a long-time TCG enthusiast, I recently discovered Altered, and like many others, I was immediately captivated by its richness and uniqueness.
about.intro_3: The goal of AlterTracker is simple: to help every player find the perfect unique card for their deck. With a market tracking system, detailed statistics, and advanced search, the app supports you in building your deck and collection.
about.intro_4: Today, AlterTracker aims to be a community-driven, evolving, and constantly improving tool. Your feedback is essential, and every new idea enriches this project designed **by a player, for players**.
about.who_1: My name is Julien, I am a software architect and expert in web application pentesting, GIAC certified. As a full-stack developer by training, I use my technical skills to serve projects I am passionate about.
about.who_2: I am the sole developer of AlterTracker, but I am not alone in this adventure. My team — friends, players, testers — plays a crucial role by testing the app, reporting bugs, and most importantly, suggesting feature ideas that make the experience better for everyone.
about.who_3: This project is above all an act of passion, fueled by the Altered community. Thank you all for your support.
about.mission_1: To provide Altered TCG players with a reliable, fast, and rich platform to explore the game's universe, optimize their decks, and track the card market — with a strong focus on accessibility, transparency, and community.
about.future_1: New features are in the works: price alerts, public decks, collection synchronization, integration with other platforms, and more.
about.future_2: Join us in this adventure and help shape the ultimate tool for Altered.
